General American supplies the English reference contexts; the IPA chart itself is cross-language. The six stages give a recommended route, not compulsory prerequisites in every case. Symbol-led analysis and recording-led investigation converge on a revisable record, not on a claim that every input has one certain answer.

title: Learn a word pronunciation

Use the six stages in the recommended order when starting; prerequisites and missing evidence determine where to enter or return. Reading this document or passing repository tests does not establish pronunciation competence.
